purpose: Preserve original final native acceptance evidence for merged Spinel PRs #208 and #216. No browser rerun or new acceptance grade is performed by preservation.

scope.responsiveness: Entire original Actions ZIP copied byte-identically, including every JSON and CPU profile.
scope.callback: Every original .json member copied byte-identically into a deterministic compact ZIP. Raw trace gzip streams, compiled JavaScript/source maps and synthetic SQLite files are inventoried but omitted.
scope.raw_callback_retention: Original full callback artifacts remain supplementary GitHub Actions archives with seven-day retention; they are not made durable by this collection.

callback_zip_encoding.reproducibility: Fixed member bytes, order and metadata; reproduce compressed ZIP bytes with the recorded zlib implementation. Member byte hashes are independent of compression implementation.

members.exclusion_reason: Supplementary synthetic fixture SQLite database or WAL/shared-memory file; original Actions artifact only; not needed to inspect the retained JSON acceptance record.

privacy_review.redaction: None; retained member bytes are unchanged. This is a scoped evidence review, not a general secret-scanning guarantee.
